svg.title: Manuel Heller, full-stack developer
svg.desc: A detailed animated camera accompanies Manuel's introduction. mh, Basel region, Switzerland Manuel Heller , Full-stack developer. Code, design & photography. Code, light, and things worth taking apart. Usually in manual mode.

svg.title: MANUAL. A different kind of focus.
svg.desc: A precision mirrorless camera in graphite metal, with a textured grip, machined lens rings and deep blue optical glass. Eight iris blades close and reopen once every twelve seconds; a cyan focus confirmation precedes a brief shutter reflection. The camera body remains still.
